question: What machine learning really is
title_suggestion: What Machine Learning Really Is? The Real Answer, Explained

sources.title: What is machine learning?
notes: Definition; pattern-based learned parameters; supervised versus unsupervised and reinforcement learning.

sources.title: Machine Learning Crash Course
notes: Data, objective, model training, evaluation, deployment and limitations.

sources.title: Overfitting
notes: Memorizing a narrow training set is not the same as generalization to new observations.

sources.title: Datasets: Dividing the original dataset
notes: Training, validation and held-out test sets serve different roles in assessing performance.

sources.title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices
notes: Data leakage can make held-out evaluation falsely optimistic.

sources.title: Machine learning types
notes: Supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, self-supervised and reinforcement approaches have distinct training objectives.

editorial_angles: Learning parameters from examples is not human understanding
Different training signals imply different useful forms of learning
Generalization and leakage make evaluation central
Deployment requires monitoring changing data and consequences
Generative output and confident phrasing are not guarantees of truth
